profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Focus on back-end engineering. Optimizing is fun!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Backend role. Working on the uStore team, which provides highly scalable and customizable data storage and processing pipelines at a low cost. Working in C++, with the typical Google stack.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend work in Ruby. 
 - Heavy experience implementing asynchronous idempotent workers using Sidekiq. 
 - Implemented Elasticsearch features and handled migration across ES versions, including CircleCI and AWS ElasticBeanstalk implications. 
 - Experience with optimization of API requests.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Mostly front-end web development work using javascript, jquery, backbone, and handlebars. Some back-end work using PHP.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
•	Created drivers in C for various modules for the MQ-9 Reaper, including the LYNX-SAR, Gorgon Stare, and PPDL.
•	Designed and created test suites in C++ and C# for above drivers
•	Wrote and performed extensive system-level test plans for above modules
•	Created and edited documentation describing function and structure of above software
•	Performed routine bug fixes and enhancements

positions.title: Online Developer
positions.description: Maintained and enhanced The Daily Californian's online properties using PHP.
